question: What is the value of {( {a + b} )³} - a³ + b³ ?
solution:
**Given :**

**{( {a + b} )³}**- a³ + b³ 

**Formula used:**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab (a + b)

**Calculation:**

(a + b)3 = a3 + b3 + 3ab (a + b)

⇒ (a + b)3 - a3 - b3 = 3ab (a + b)

add 2b³ both side,

⇒ (a + b)3 - a3 - b3 + 2b3 = 3ab (a + b) + 2b3

⇒ (a + b)3 - a3 + b3 = 3ab (a + b) + 2b3

**∴ The value of bf {( {a + b} )³} - bf a³ + bf b³ is 3ab (a + b) + 2b3.**
